crossrefs.text: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
So Moses took the blood, splattered it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of Godʼs mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
